neighbours.label: Harry Potter character names inside Harry Potter story text (Ron, Neville, Luna, the Dursleys), mostly as the person another character acts toward; the same first names, or other franchises' characters, stay quiet
fire: Hermione sighed and passed her notes to Ron under the desk.
Professor McGonagall frowned at Neville when the teacup exploded.
At Hogwarts that winter, Harry taught Luna and Neville the Patronus charm.
Malfoy shoved past Ron on the way out of Potions.
Hagrid waved to Hermione and Ron from the edge of the Forbidden Forest.
Back at Privet Drive, Harry avoided the Dursleys for most of the summer.
Ginny laughed as Fred and George teased Ron about the Quidditch match.
Snape took ten points from Gryffindor after Neville melted another cauldron.
